title: 第1065章  时间紧迫第1064章 新的道则
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 他对道则的理解在飞速提升，不是量的积累，而是质的蜕变，如同一个在黑暗中摸索许久的旅人终于看到一片辽阔的天地。
气息，也随之开始再度疯狂攀升。圣境后期巅峰的瓶颈如同薄冰般无声碎裂，武道境界势如破竹地跨入圣境大圆满。
十三种道则加上六种新道则，十九种道则之力在他周身交织成一道横贯天地的璀璨光环，光环旋转之间，虚空都在微微扭曲。
然而，就在他即将触及那层通往神境的屏障时，一股无形的压制骤然降临。
那压制不是来自外界，而是来自天地本身，来自此界早已残缺的规则根基。
如一座摇摇欲坠的大厦，当有人试图在它顶层再添一层时，整座建筑都在发出不堪重负的哀鸣。
方云逸眉头微微皱起。他感受到，那道通往神境的门户并非被完全关闭，而是因为此界的天地本源实在太过枯竭，规则太过残缺，如一座千疮百孔的桥梁，再也无法承受更沉重的脚步。
即便剑塔能强行替他开辟一条道路，那条道路也必然是以此界天地本源的进一步崩碎为代价。
他缓缓呼出一口浊气，那双深邃如渊的眼眸中浮现出一丝明悟。
圣境之后，是对道则的感悟与修炼，每一缕道则的领悟都需要岁月的沉淀与积累。
而他与常人又不同，常人需要花费数百年、数千年才能将一种道则参悟到足以支撑突破的程度，而他借助剑塔的力量，可以在极短的时间内接触并融合多种道则本源。
但即便如此，一个大境界的突破，也不是一蹴而就的。神境，那是超越圣境的另一个层次，是对道则的极致掌控与融合！
是将自身小世界真正凝练成一方独立天地的关键一步。即便有剑塔的帮助，他也不能在这样的时刻强行突破。
方云逸微微摇头，压下心中那股对更高境界的渴望。他知道，最近突破得太快，根基虽稳，却缺少岁月的打磨。
他需要先稳固，需要让这十九种道则在他的小世界中真正融为一体，如同一条条河流汇入大海，而不是简单地堆砌。
于是，他将那些正在涌入小世界的道则之力，以圣人之魂为引，缓缓引导向圣人之魂本身。风、水、光、暗、生、亡……
六种新道则如同六条温润的溪流，顺着他的经脉流淌而上，最终融入识海深处那道金色的虚影之中。
圣人之魂在道则滋养下开始发生深入变化。原本因为大战而留下暗伤的地方被逐一修复，裂纹愈合的速度比之前快出数倍。
而那些道则融入圣魂后，如同一枚枚被镶嵌上去的宝石，让圣魂的光芒变得更加璀璨、更加厚重。
风的道则让圣魂感知变得更加灵动，能够捕捉到天地间最细微的元气流动。
水的道则让圣魂的韧性大幅提升，如同万古不化的冰川深处涌动着的暖流。
光的道则让圣魂净化之力更加纯粹，能驱散一切侵蚀。暗的道则则让圣魂的隐匿能力更上一层楼，如同融入夜色的影子。
生之道则让圣魂的自我修复能力变得前所未有的强大，而亡之道则让圣魂在面对腐朽与侵蚀时拥有更加坚韧的抵抗力。
十九种道则，在圣人之魂上交织成一道前所未有的璀璨光环。
那道虚影如同被精心雕琢过无数次的琉璃，每一寸都散发着温润而威严的光芒。
方云逸的气息，也在这一过程中变得更加强大、更加浓厚，如同一座正在缓缓蓄积力量的火山，虽未喷发，却已让人感受到那股即将撼动天地的磅礴。
将心神从圣人之魂上收回，嘴角浮现出一丝满意的弧度。圣魂的伤势已经完全恢复，甚至比受伤之前更加强大。
十九种道则的融入，让他对天地道则的理解达到一个前所未有的高度。
然而，还没来得急体会这新生力量，整个剑塔六层的虚空骤然一阵剧烈震颤。
那股震颤不是来自剑塔内部，而是从外界传来，穿透层层空间壁垒，如同一头沉睡的巨兽被猛然惊醒时发出的怒吼。
方云逸的瞳孔微微收缩，能感受到那股震颤中蕴含的意义……封印正在承受前所未有的冲击。
他的神念如无形触手穿透剑塔壁垒，探向外界，瞬息之间便捕捉到圣渊之下的惨烈景象。莫山虽以残躯之力勉强稳住封印，但异域的冲击远比想象中更加猛烈，封印光幕上的裂纹正在以一种让人心惊的速度蔓延。
与此同时，封印光幕另一侧，那片灰黑色混沌雾气笼罩的虚空，四位真神境老祖的面色已经阴沉得如同暴风雨来临前的天穹。
摩罗耶老祖悬浮在最前方，灰黑色长袍在翻涌的雾气中猎猎翻卷，岩石般苍老的面容上，此刻布满压抑到极致的怒火。
他盯着那道依旧横亘在天地间的封印光幕，双眼中燃烧着的火焰几乎要穿透虚空。
已经整整十二天。十二天前，他们本以为那一日的冲击足以将封印彻底撕碎，本以为玄天大陆的内耗会让封印再无修复之力。
可这道该死屏障，这道摇摇欲坠、布满裂纹的金色光幕，却如同一个垂死的老人般死撑着不肯倒下！
整整十二天，他们以无数低阶生灵的鲜血腐蚀，以数不清的冲击消耗，却始终没能将它彻底击溃。
摩罗耶老祖目光落在光幕的基座处。
那里，低阶生灵尸体已经堆积如山，暗紫色、灰黑色、各色的血液汇聚成一座粘稠的血湖，将封印光幕的基座浸泡在浓郁的腐臭与腥甜之中。
尸体层层叠叠，有的还保持着撞击封印时的狰狞姿态，有的已经被后来的尸体压得变形碎裂，骨肉混杂在一起，如同一座由血肉堆砌而成的山峦。
而在那些尸山血海之间，还有无数低阶生灵正在麻木地、如同失去灵魂的傀儡般继续向前冲锋，然后一头撞在封印光幕上，炸裂成血肉碎片。
它们眼神空洞，只剩下本能、被驱使的疯狂，如一波又一波被推向绞肉机的浪潮。

His understanding of Taoism is improving rapidly, not an accumulation of quantity, but a transformation of quality, like a traveler who has been groping in the dark for a long time and finally sees a vast world.
The breath also began to rise crazily again. The bottleneck at the peak of the late stage of the Holy Realm shattered silently like thin ice, and the martial arts realm entered the Holy Realm of Great Perfection like a broken bamboo.
The thirteen Tao Principles plus six new Tao Principles, the power of the nineteen Tao Principles intertwined around him to form a bright halo across the sky and the earth. As the halo rotated, the void was slightly distorted.
However, just when he was about to touch the barrier leading to the divine realm, an invisible suppression suddenly came.
That suppression does not come from the outside world, but from the heaven and earth itself, from the already incomplete foundation of rules in this world.
Like a crumbling building, the whole building groans under its weight as someone tries to add another floor to its top.
Fang Yunyi frowned slightly. He felt that the portal to the divine realm was not completely closed, but because the source of heaven and earth in this realm was too exhausted and the rules were too incomplete. It was like a bridge riddled with holes and could no longer withstand heavier footsteps.
Even if the sword tower can forcibly open a path for him, that path must be at the cost of further collapse of the origin of this world.
He slowly exhaled a breath, and a hint of understanding appeared in his eyes as deep as the abyss.
After the holy realm, there is the understanding and cultivation of Taoism. The understanding of each Taoism requires years of precipitation and accumulation.
And he is different from ordinary people. It takes hundreds or thousands of years for ordinary people to understand a Tao to a level that is enough to support a breakthrough. However, with the power of the sword tower, he can contact and integrate the origins of multiple Tao in a very short period of time.
But even so, a breakthrough in a big realm does not happen overnight. Divine realm, that is another level beyond the holy realm, it is the ultimate control and integration of Tao principles!
It is a key step to truly condense your own small world into an independent world. Even with the help of the sword tower, he couldn't force a breakthrough at such a moment.
Fang Yunyi shook his head slightly, suppressing the desire for a higher realm in his heart. He knew that his breakthroughs had been too rapid recently, and that although his foundation was solid, it lacked the polish of years.
He needs to stabilize it first, and he needs to make these nineteen Tao principles truly integrated in his small world, like rivers flowing into the sea, rather than simply piled up.
Therefore, he used the soul of the saint as a guide to slowly guide the power of Tao that was pouring into the small world towards the soul of the saint itself. Wind, water, light, darkness, life, death...
The six new paths are like six warm streams, flowing up his meridians, and finally blending into the golden shadow deep in the sea of consciousness.
The soul of the saint begins to undergo profound changes under the nourishment of Tao. The hidden wounds originally caused by the war were repaired one by one, and the cracks healed several times faster than before.
And after those Tao are integrated into the Holy Soul, they are like inlaid gems, making the light of the Holy Soul more brilliant and thicker.
The path of wind makes the Holy Soul's perception become more agile, able to capture the smallest flow of vitality between heaven and earth.
The path of water greatly enhances the toughness of the holy soul, just like the warm current surging deep in the eternal glacier.
The path of light makes the purifying power of the Holy Soul purer and can dispel all erosion. The Tao of Darkness takes the Holy Soul's hiding ability to a higher level, like a shadow blending into the night.
The way of life makes the self-healing ability of the holy soul become more powerful than ever, while the way of death makes the holy soul more resilient in the face of decay and erosion.
The nineteen kinds of Tao are intertwined into an unprecedented bright halo on the soul of the saint.
The phantom was like glass that had been carefully carved countless times, with every inch exuding a warm and majestic light.
Fang Yunyi's aura also became stronger and thicker in the process, like a volcano that was slowly accumulating power. Although it had not erupted, it already made people feel the majesty that was about to shake the world.
Withdrawing his mind from the saint's soul, a trace of satisfaction appeared on the corner of his mouth. The Holy Soul has fully recovered from its injuries and is even stronger than before the injury.
The integration of nineteen kinds of principles brought his understanding of the principles of heaven and earth to an unprecedented level.
However, before he could realize this new power, the entire void on the sixth floor of the sword tower suddenly trembled violently.
The tremor did not come from inside the sword tower, but came from the outside world, penetrating through the layers of space barriers, like the roar of a sleeping giant when it was suddenly awakened.
Fang Yunyi's pupils contracted slightly, and he could feel the meaning contained in the tremor... The seal was undergoing an unprecedented impact.
His spiritual thoughts penetrated the sword tower barrier like invisible tentacles, explored the outside world, and captured the tragic scene under the holy abyss in an instant. Although Mo Shan managed to stabilize the seal with the strength of his remaining body, the impact of the foreign land was far more violent than imagined, and the cracks on the seal's light screen were spreading at a frightening speed.
At the same time, on the other side of the sealed light curtain, in the void shrouded in gray-black chaotic mist, the faces of the four True God Realm ancestors were as gloomy as the sky before a storm.
Ancestor Moroye was suspended in the front, his gray-black robes billowing in the surging mist, and his rock-like old face was filled with extremely suppressed anger.
He stared at the sealed light curtain that still stretched between heaven and earth, and the burning flames in his eyes almost penetrated the void.
It has been twelve full days. Twelve days ago, they thought that the impact of that day was enough to completely tear the seal into pieces. They thought that the internal friction of Xuantian Continent would make it impossible to repair the seal.
But this damn barrier, this shaky golden light curtain full of cracks, is holding on like a dying old man and refusing to fall!
For twelve days, they corroded it with the blood of countless low-level creatures and consumed it with countless impacts, but they still failed to completely defeat it.
Patriarch Moroye’s gaze fell on the base of the light curtain.
There, the corpses of low-level creatures have piled up like a mountain, and dark purple, gray-black, and various colors of blood have gathered into a viscous blood lake, soaking the base of the sealing light curtain in a rich putrid smell and fishy sweetness.
The corpses are piled on top of each other, some still retain the ferocious posture when they hit the seal, and some have been deformed and broken by the subsequent corpses, with bones and flesh mixed together, like a mountain made of flesh and blood.
And among those mountains of corpses and seas of blood, there were countless low-level creatures that were numbly continuing to charge forward like puppets that had lost their souls. Then they hit the sealing light curtain and exploded into pieces of flesh and blood.
Their eyes are empty, leaving only instinctive, driven madness, like waves being pushed into a meat grinder.
